title: Program-Size Percentage Table for the Paystride Instant Pay Disbursement Service Platform Fee
content:
**Clause.** An employer whose live Paystride Earned Wage Access Program Agreement is on the Paystride Program Enterprise, Paystride Program Enterprise Plus or Paystride Program Strategic tier earns 10 percent on the platform fee of a completed billing month of its Paystride Instant Pay Disbursement Service, one whose live agreement is on the Paystride Program Professional tier earns 5 percent, and any other employer earns no program-size percentage.

The program tier is the tier recorded on the employer's live Paystride Earned Wage Access Program Agreement.

| Program tier of the live agreement | Program-size percentage |
|---|---|
| Paystride Program Strategic | 10 percent |
| Paystride Program Enterprise Plus | 10 percent |
| Paystride Program Enterprise | 10 percent |
| Paystride Program Professional | 5 percent |
| Paystride Program Growth | none |
| Paystride Program Starter | none |
| no live agreement | none |

An agreement on the Paystride Program Enterprise tier that is not live, for example one still implementing, earns nothing: the percentage follows a live agreement only.
